# UX-STING Agent Skills

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-agent-skills.mjs — do not edit; edit .claude/skills/ and rebuild. -->

Make coding agents build **accessible, themeable, art-directed UI** with the
UX-STING React design system (`@ux-sting/react`). The skills below teach component
choice, tokens/themes, accessibility review, art direction, the QA pipeline,
3D, diagrams and logo/identity work. They are tool-neutral: the same
`SKILL.md` folders work in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot / VS Code,
Gemini CLI, Qoder and other Agent Skills hosts.

## Install (universal)

```bash
npx skills add ssassam/UX-STING    # detects your agent (Cursor, Codex, Gemini, Copilot/VS Code…)
```

**Claude Code** can install this whole repo as a native plugin/marketplace:

```
/plugin marketplace add ssassam/UX-STING
/plugin install ux-sting@ux-sting
```

**OpenAI Codex** auto-discovers the skills in this repo from `.agents/skills/` (a generated mirror of `.claude/skills/`). Run `/skills` to list them or `$ux-sting-taste` to invoke one.

Or drop these skill folders into your host's skills directory (e.g.
`.claude/skills/`, your Cursor/Codex/Gemini skills folder, or the Qoder plugin).
Source of truth lives in `.claude/skills/`.

## Runtime dependencies

- `@ux-sting/react` + React 18/19 and Tailwind CSS 4 for the UI skills.
- The `ux-sting` CLI for QA / token extraction / images: `npm i -D ux-sting @ux-sting/qa @ux-sting/extract @ux-sting/images` then `npx playwright-core install chromium`.
- Python 3 for the `logo-design` scripts (dependency-free stdlib only).

## Universal Design Agent

One persona that routes any UI task to the right skill and always verifies before finishing.
- **Claude Code / Qoder:** native subagent `ux-sting-universal-design` (from `agents/`).
- **Codex:** `$ux-sting-design-agent` · **Cursor / Copilot:** `@ux-sting-design-agent` · **Gemini:** auto by task.
